Full details: Title check

**Explanation** The title names the change: it adds null stop_reason and stop_sequence to the InvokeModel stream message_start event for the Bedrock provider. It matches the diff, which adds these two keys to the message_start map in core/providers/bedrock/invoke.go, plus a regression test and a changelog entry. The title uses the conventional fix(scope) form and is specific enough for a reviewer scanning history.
Full details: Description check

**Explanation** The description follows the repository template. It includes a Summary that states the problem and the cause, a Changes list naming the files and the new test, a Type of change (Bug fix checked), Affected areas (Core and Providers checked), and a How to test section with commands and expected results. Breaking changes is answered (No) and Related issues links `#9538`. Security considerations and the checklist are not filled in, and the screenshot section is omitted, but these are non-critical for a backend bug fix that touches no security surface. The Summary also explains that the test fails without the change, which supports the claim of regression coverage.
Full details: Linked Issues check

**Explanation** [`#9538`] requires `message_start.message` on `/bedrock/model/{id}/invoke-with-response-stream` to carry `stop_reason` and `stop_sequence` as JSON null. The whole-PR diff (merge base to reviewed head) adds `"stop_reason": nil` and `"stop_sequence": nil` to the `msgStart` message map in `toAnthropicInvokeStreamBytes` (`core/providers/bedrock/invoke.go`). Go encodes nil map values as JSON null, so both keys are present with null values. The whole-PR diff of `core/providers/bedrock/invoke_test.go` adds `TestToAnthropicInvokeStreamBytes_MessageStartHasNullStopFields`. It unmarshals the first frame and asserts that both keys are present and nil. This test covers the automated-test part of the issue. The `message_delta` branch and the `message_start.usage` behavior from `#5885` are unchanged, which matches the issue scope. The coding requirement is met.
Full details: Out of Scope Changes check

**Explanation** The whole-PR code changes are limited to the `message_start` message map in `core/providers/bedrock/invoke.go` (two key-value pairs and a short comment) and one regression test in `core/providers/bedrock/invoke_test.go`. All of these implement [`#9538`] directly. The changelog entry in `core/changelog.md` (taken from the raw summary; not re-read in this review) describes the same fix. No unrelated change is identified. The changelog was not inspected directly, so this is a minor residual uncertainty and does not affect the verdict.
